title: One-Pot Pasta with Fresh Tomatoes
summary: This rustic method of cooking pasta directly in tomato sauce creates an incredibly creamy dish where pasta absorbs all the flavours.

steps.text: Heat olive oil in large, wide pan over medium heat. Add sliced garlic and chili (if using). Cook 1 minute until fragrant - do not brown.
Add polpa pelati and crush any larger pieces with wooden spoon. Season with salt, add torn basil. Simmer 5 minutes to develop flavour.
Add raw pasta directly to sauce, stirring to coat each piece. Add water or stock to just barely cover pasta. Liquid should be level with pasta.
Cook at steady simmer, stirring frequently to prevent sticking and release starch. Keep adding splashes of water when dry. Cook 12-15 minutes until al dente.
When pasta is al dente and sauce clings nicely, remove from heat. Stir in more fresh basil and drizzle of olive oil.
Serve immediately with freshly grated Parmesan.

tips: Success depends on frequent stirring and liquid adjustment. Use a wide pan for even cooking. Slice garlic rather than mince - slices soften during cooking, giving milder, sweeter flavour. The pasta's released starch creates the creamy texture.
